impact_scope.description: A new public std/webp decoder implementing base.image_decoder introduces a caller-visible WebP decoding entry and lifecycle.

evidence: S0 has no matching std/webp decoder declaration, so this newly introduced decoder had no same-identity exposure obligation before the commit.
S1 introduces public struct decoder implementing base.image_decoder with public image-config, frame-config, and frame-decoding calls in std/webp/decode_webp.wuffs.
H0 compiles only AUX BASE, AUX JSON, BASE, and JSON modules and exercises JSON decoders; it neither enables std/webp nor constructs or calls the new WebP decoder.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 must enable the WebP production module and add a WebP decoder entry/lifecycle using caller-supplied encoded input, including the image-config, frame-config, and frame decode path. None of these actions existed in S0.
evidence: The anchored public std/webp decoder is absent in S0 and introduced in S1.
H0's module configuration and fuzz entry paths are exclusively JSON-oriented, so the new decoder is unreachable without harness changes.

reason: For the anchored new std/webp decoder, Gap(S0,H0) is false because the declaration did not exist, while Gap(S1,H0) is true because unchanged H0 cannot compile or invoke it. This is a new caller-visible harness obligation, not an aggravation of the unrelated pre-existing omission of another module.
